nodes.name: DA-Ru-W Precursor Formation
nodes.procedure: Firstly, 5 mmol dopamine hydrochloride (DA) was dispersed in DI water. Then the DA-solution was adjusted to pH~2 by adding 1 M HCl. After that, 0.5 mmol RuCl3 was added into the DA solution and mixed well by agitation under 0 °C to form crimson DA-Ru solution. Subsequently, 0.1 M Na2WO4 solution dropwisely added into the DA-Ru solution with continuous stirring over 4.0 h. The metal-organic compounds with flower-like morphology assembled by nanosheets or flakes DA-Ru-W precursor were centrifugated, washed and then dried at 60 °C.

nodes.name: Ru/C Synthesis
nodes.procedure: 90 mg of carbon black (Vulcan XC-72R) was added into 40 ml absolute ethanol under constant stirring and ultrasonic dispersion for 1.0 h. Then 10 mL 1 M RuCl3 ethanol solution was dropwisely added into the carbon black solution under continuously stirring for 3.0 h. After that the solution was then maintained at 80 °C and put on a heating plate. Finally, the products were pyrolyzed at 800 °C for 2.0 h under Ar atmosphere.

nodes.name: NiFe-LDH Hydrothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Ni(NO3)2·6H2O (0.2990 g), Fe(NO3)3·9H2O (0.1385 g) and CO(NH2)2 (0.1287 g) were dissolved in 15 mL DI. Subsequently, the mixed solution and Ni foam (2.25 × 3.0 cm2) were transferred to Teflon autoclave and then heated at 120 °C for 12 h to obtain NiFe layered double hydroxide nanosheets on NF, named as NiFe-LDH.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru-NPs/WCx exhibits good crystallinity of WC (PDF#51-0939) and W2C (PDF#35-0776) phases with no recognizable diffraction peaks of metallic Ru.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 1b, Ru·NPs/WC× exhibits good crystallinity of WC (PDF#51-0939) and W2C (PDF#35-0776) phases... No recognizable diffraction peaks of metallic Ru can be found within the detection limits...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru-NPs/WCx maintains the microspherical morphology of the DA-Ru-W precursor.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) demonstrates that Ru·NPs/WC× maintains the microspherical morphology of the DA-Ru-W precursor...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru-NPs/WCx is composed of WCx NPs uniformly distributed on carbon sheets.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The transmission electron microscopy (TEM) (Supplementary Fig. 5) and high-angle annular dark-field STEM (HAADF-STEM) (Fig. 1c and Supplementary Fig. 6a) images clearly demonstrate that the Ru·NPs/WC× are composed of WCx NPs uniformly distributed on carbon sheets.

nodes.characterization_summary: Enlarged HAADF-STEM images show Ru NPs on edge of WCx nanocrystals with interplanar distances 0.255 nm ((100) WC), 0.259 nm (W2C), and 0.214 nm ((200) Ru); EELS line scan confirms Ru mainly on WCx surface/edge.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The enlarged HAADF-STEM and corresponding Energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) mapping images reveal the Ru NPs spreading on the edge of WCx nanocrystals support (Fig. 1d and Supplementary Figs. 6, 7). As depicted in Fig. 1e, f and Supplementary Fig. 6b, the distinct interplanar distance of 0.255 nm and 0.259 nm matches with (100) plane of WC and W2C... The order lattice fringes with spacing of 0.214 nm ((200) plane) is clearly distinguished on Ru NPs region (Fig. 1e, f). Moreover, the HAADF-STEM and electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) were further conducted... Figure 1g shows the EELS spectra of Ru-M2,3 along the line scan...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru-M2,3 EELS spectra confirm Ru NPs mainly anchored on WCx surface and edge.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 1g shows the EELS spectra of Ru-M2,3 along the line scan... it is found that Ru NPs mainly anchored on the WCx surface and edge...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru-NPs/WCx exhibits Brunauer-Emmett-Teller surface area of 322.1 m² g⁻¹ and is mesopore-dominant with pores mainly distributed at 2~4 nm; WCx has 362.3 m² g⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The N2 sorption analysis reveals that the Ru-NPs/WCx catalyst exhibits a high specific surface area (322.1 m² g⁻¹, Supplementary Table 2) due to the presence of amorphous carbon sheet, which is relatively lower than WC× (362.3 m² g⁻¹, Supplementary Table 2)... Pore size distribution exhibits that more mesoporous structures are mainly distributed at 2~4 nm, compared with WC×.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru content in Ru-NPs/WCx is 2.88 wt%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: ICP-OES results reveal that the amounts of Ru in Ru/WC× are 1.38, 2.88 and 4.92 wt%... for Ru-NPs/WCx...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru 3p in Ru-NPs/WCx shows positive shift of 0.15 eV compared to Ru/C indicating electron transfer from Ru to WCx; W 4f shows negative shift of ~0.10 eV for W-C 4f7/2 peak.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 2a shows the Ru 3p spectra of Ru·NPs/WC× and Ru/C, where Ru-NPs/WCx exhibits a positive peak shift of 0.15 eV in the Ru 3p binding energy (BE) of metallic Ru⁰ compared to Ru/C... W 4f shows a negative-shift in the BE of W-C 4f7/2 peak of ~ 0.10 eV for Ru-NPs/WCx compared to WCx...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru K-edge XANES of Ru-NPs/WCx shows positive shift relative to Ru foil confirming electron transfer from Ru to WCx.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectra (Fig. 2c), the absorption edge of Ru-NPs/WCx exhibits an apparent positive shift relative to Ru foil... which further confirms the electron transfer from Ru to WCx...

nodes.characterization_summary: FT-EXAFS shows Ru-Ru coordination peak at 2.45 Å and weak Ru-C scattering path at 1.50 Å in Ru-NPs/WCx.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Fourier transforms of the extended X-ray absorption fine structure spectra (FT-EXAFS) of Ru·NPs/WC× (Fig. 2d) exhibits a predominant coordination peak located at 2.45 Å corresponding to the Ru-Ru coordination, and the weak peak at 1.50 Å, ascribed to the Ru-C scattering path...

nodes.characterization_summary: Work function of Ru-NPs/WCx is 3.68 eV, smaller than WCx (4.19 eV); valence band maximum shifts negatively by 0.42 eV compared to Ru/C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 2h presents the WF described by ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy (UPS), where the secondary electron cutoff energy (Ecutoff) exhibits an increase from 17.76 eV for WC× to 18.36 eV for Ru·NPs/WC×. Accordingly, the calculated WF of Ru-NPs/WCx is 3.68 eV, much smaller than that of WCx (4.19 eV... the valence band maximum position (EVBM) of Ru·NPs/WC× shifts negatively by 0.42 eV than Ru/C

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM-EDS mappings and EDS mapping confirm Ru NPs dispersed on WCx surface with Ru species covering WCx surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The enlarged HAADF-STEM and corresponding Energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) mapping images reveal the Ru NPs spreading on the edge of WCx nanocrystals support (Fig. 1d and Supplementary Figs. 6, 7)... The corresponding EELS mapping images (Supplementary Fig. 8) confirm that the Ru-NPs are dispersed on the WCx surface. The EDS mapping also distinctively confirms the WCx surface is mainly covered with Ru species (Supplementary Fig. 9).
